incident: D-051 fail-closed. This gate's 'I could not look' branch is distinct from its 'I found an uncited count' branch, and only the second was fixtured. A named target that cannot be read must exit 2, never 0: a counts gate that silently skips an unreadable document reports clean over exactly the file someone wanted checked. Added after the tightened contract reported this gate had no exit-2 case.
